scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run sync:static
scripts.sync:static: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join('frontend', 'out'); const dest = path.join('backend', 'app', 'static'); fs.cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('✓ Synced frontend build into backend/app/static');"
